statement.text: Does there exist a non-linear entire function $g$ with wandering domain $W$ such that $\bigcup_{n\geq0}g^n(W)$ is bounded in $\mathbb{C}$? It has been conjectured by Lyubich that if $g$ and $W$ exist, then $g^n(W)$ cannot converge as $n\to\infty$ to a fixed point of $g$. (M. R. Herman; A. Eremenko and M. Yu. Lyubich)
